availability_response.AVAILABLE: Requested historical characterization exists with an exact source-fenced case mapping; evidence may then be revealed under the committed request.
availability_response.UNAVAILABLE: No matching archived characterization is present in the frozen source. This is missing follow-up, not evidence against the scientific claim.
availability_response.NOT_ADMITTED: The characterization class or exact case mapping is not source-fenced enough to reveal.

guards: Do not sweep availability across cases before committing a scientific selection.
Do not substitute a different characterization after an unavailable result within the same frozen request.
Historical R2 can adjudicate a selected case but cannot by itself estimate prospective selector precision across uncharacterized cases.
